newsitem.title: USA: DBS Industries says wins $4.1 mln damages.
newsitem.headline: DBS Industries says wins $4.1 mln damages.

text.p: DBS Industries Inc said on Friday a Superior Court of the State of California has awarded the company $4.1 million in damages in a case involving Loral Aerospace Holdings Inc and Continental Satellite Corp.

DBS said it bought 72,030 shares of Continental Satellite common stock from IntraSpace Corp of Salt Lake City for $2.3 million. IntraSpace received the shares from Continental as partial payment on a satellite construction contract.

After DBS bought the shares, it said Loral, a majority shareholder of Continental, sued Continental, IntraSpace, and other Continental shareholders alleging shares issued to IntraSpace were invalidly issued and void. DBSI said it became involved in the suit to protect its investment.
Judgment for damages would be entered jointly and severally against Loral Aerospace and Continental Satellite, DBS said.
